pages.text: Brew these ingredients into $(item)Aqua Vitae$() to make Flavoring Essence. Each bottle is single-use. Double flavors use a second infusion of the same ingredient; Mixed Berry uses Sweet Berry Essence + Glow Berries.

pages.title: Apple
pages.text: $(item)Apple$() → Apple Essence$(br)Fresh Apple Essence + Apple → Double Apple Essence$(br2)$(item)Golden Apple$() → Golden Apple Essence$(br)Fresh Golden Apple Essence + Golden Apple → Double Golden Apple Essence

pages.text: $(item)Enchanted Golden Apple$() → Royal Golden Apple Essence$(br)Fresh Royal Golden Apple Essence + Enchanted Golden Apple → Double Royal Apple Essence
